name: mc_sirius_b_lpqi_pathfinder
label: Sirius B diameter Monte Carlo on the LPQI-Pathfinder (NOT + TNG, 550 m, one 1 nm filter)
notes: The Pathfinder's own use case (angular sizes of bright compact stars); the photon budget uses the geometric mean of the NOT and TNG apertures.
Sirius (dec -16.7) culminates at zenith angle 45.5 deg from the NOT (lat 28.76): the blocks sit at 46, 52.5 and 60 deg (the EON-SII study's 45 deg block is unreachable here).
